en: A sepia-toned historic postcard-style illustration of a spacious castle courtyard. On the left is an ornate multi-storey Renaissance stair tower with rich decoration; in the center background rises a tall, slender tower with a spire. Surrounding buildings form an enclosed court with arched doorways and windows. In the foreground stands a fountain with a sculpted figure holding a trident beside a rectangular basin. German text is printed at the top in red Fraktur-style script.
